<entry id="I00822">
<head-word>טְרִיקְלִין, </head-word>
<head-word>טְרַקְלִין</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (τρικλίνιον, triclinium) l) 
<italic>dining couch</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ḥag. II, 77
<sup>a</sup> bot. הט' מוצע לכם the banqueting couch is spread for you (your reward in the hereafter is prepared).—2) 
<italic>dining room, reception room</italic>. Y. R. Hash. IV, 59
<sup>b</sup> bot. אפ' מט' לקיטון even if they adjourned from the tricl. to the sleeping room. Y. Keth. IV, 28
<sup>d</sup>; Y. Snh. XI, end, 30
<sup>c</sup> [read:] בעיא הדא אומנתא ט' וקיטין חופה וקיטון וכ' the following construction is required (in order to make the reception of the bride in the triclinium a legal consummation of marriage) a tricl. and a marriage chamber, and that chamber communicating with the tricl.—Ab. IV, 16, v. פְּרוֹזְדּוֹר.—Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 18 ט' שהסיקה … בה in a banqueting room (triclinium hibernum) which has been heated a day before …, you may entertain company on the Sabbath. Tosef. Bets. II, 10 ט' שהסיקוהו וכ'; a. e.—3) (τρίκλινος = ὅρριον, S.) 
<italic>granary</italic>. Y. Sot. V, 20
<sup>b</sup> bot. איטלק עלוי חד ט' וכ' he was fined to fill a granary of forty by forty &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>

<italic>preserve, pickle</italic>, esp. 
<italic>salted</italic> or 
<italic>pickled fish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 6
<sup>a</sup> טמוני זו ט' ‘stored things’ (Deut. XXXIII, 19) refers to 
<italic>tarith</italic> (as a valuable article of commerce); Sifré Deut. 354; Num. R. s. 13.—Ab. Zar. II, 6 ט' טרופה brine containing hashed

<italic>t</italic>. Ber. 44
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00859">
<head-word>טָרַף</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. טָרַד)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to move with vehemence</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tear, prey</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 26 טוֹרֵף ואוכל tears in order to 
<pgbrk id="pg556" />satisfy his appetite. Koh. R. to X, 11 הארי ט' the lion goes out for prey. Sot. 47
<sup>b</sup> טוֹרְפֵי טֶרֶף those robbing (the poor). Zeb. 53
<sup>b</sup> חלקו של טוֹרֵף the territory of the tearer (wolf = Benjamin, Gen. XLIX, 27). B. Kam. 116
<sup>b</sup> לטוֹרְפָהּ to plunder it; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cast with force, knock, strike against; to throw away, reject, eject</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. III, 3 טְרָפָהּ בכותל he cast or knocked the bird against the wall. Pesik. R. s. 11; Num. R. s. 2 מגרשה אני טוֹרְפָהּ אני I will divorce her, I will cast her out (cmp. טָרַד).—Ber. 5
<sup>b</sup> טוֹרְפִין לו וכ' his prayer is thrown in his face (refused). Y. Yeb. XVI, 15
<sup>d</sup> top טְרָפַנִי, v. טָרַד.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to seize forcibly.</italic></definition>
<notes> Yoma IV, 1 ט' בקלפי he took the ballot out with haste.—Esp. 
<italic>to seize for a debt</italic>. B. Mets. 15
<sup>a</sup> ובא ב"ח וטְרָפָהּ and a creditor of the previous owner came and seized it, v. טִירְפָּא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to chop, hash, to beat, mix</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. XIX, 2 ט' יין ושמן beat wine and oil; a. e.—Part. pass. טָרוּף, f. טְרוּפָה. Ib. 38
<sup>a</sup> בשר ט' chopped meat. Ab. Zar. II, 6, v. טָרִית. Y. Nidd. IV, 51
<sup>a</sup> (of a foetus). Sabb. VIII, 5 (80
<sup>b</sup>) ביצה ט' an egg beaten and mixed with oil; a. fr. V. טָרוּף.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to hackle, comb</italic> (flax or wool).</definition>
<notes> Kil. IX, 1. Y. Orl. III, 63
<sup>a</sup>; Y. Keth. VI, end, 31
<sup>a</sup> צמר בכור שטְרָפוֹ wool of a first-born that has been hackled (and mixed up with, other wool).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—6)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to scrape, scour, to plane.</italic></definition>
<notes> Makhsh. II, 4 הטוֹרֵף את גגו (Var. המטהר) if one scrubs his roof; Tosef. ib. I, 8.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—7)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make</italic> טְרֵפָה, 
<italic>to inflict an organic defect</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 85
<sup>b</sup>, sq. צא טְרוֹף go and maim the animal (before slaughtering it).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִטְרַף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become t’refah</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 9
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. במה נִטְרְפָה from what cause it became 
<italic>t’refah</italic></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be in disorder</italic>, a) (with דעה, or לב) 
<italic>to be confused, bewildered, not fully conscious</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. II, 5
<sup>b</sup> bot. נִטְרְפָה דעתו של אבא my father’s mind is unclear; Snh. 68
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. 43
<sup>a</sup> כדי שתִּטָּרֵף דעתו (not שתטרוף) that his (the culprit’s) consciousness may be benumbed; Num. R. s. 10.—Ib. נ' לבו his mind becomes confused (from drinking); a. fr.—b) (with שעה, of political disturbances) 
<italic>to be troubled</italic>. Snh. 11
<sup>a</sup>; Sot. 48
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. ib. XIII, 5 נטרפה (ה)שעה the political condition was too much troubled (persecutions prevailing). Y. Dem. V, 24
<sup>d</sup> bot.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>טֵרֵף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to shake vehemently, constantly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Succ. III, 9 כל העם מטָרְפִין בלולביהן ed. Y. (Mish. ed. Pes. מט'את לול'; ed. מנעועין) all the people shook their branches constantly (during the recitation at Hallel, contrad. to נענע).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to unbalance</italic> (the mind, cmp. טִלְטֵל).</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. מְטוֹרָף. Num. R. s. 10 לבו מ' וכ' his mind is disturbed and he talks improper things, v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to reject one’s petition, to refuse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. מְטוֹרָף. Ber. V, 5 שהוא מ' that he (the patient for whom prayer is said) is rejected (bound to die), opp. מקובל accepted.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to disfigure, to make ungainly</italic> by spots, incisions &c., v. 
<xref rid="I00439">טָרוּף</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. as ab. Koh. R. to X, 11 the serpent is asked מפני מה גופך מט' why has thy body been disfigured (v. Gen. III, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cast about</italic> (a ship on high sea), v. Hithpa.—Part.</definition>
<notes> pass. as ab.; 
<italic>pl</italic>. מְטוֹרָפִים, מְטוֹרָפִין. Yeb. 47
<sup>a</sup>, v. סָחַף.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִטְרִיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become t’refah, to be afflicted with a fatal organic disease</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 12, end; Cant. R. to VI, 4; Pesik. Vayhi p. 10
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. לא הִטְרִיפוּ the animals were found to be free from an organic disease.—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> (in later liter.) 
<italic>to declare t’refah</italic>.</definition>
<notes>.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (denom. of טֶרֶף) a) 
<italic>to cover with foliage</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Gen. 119, v. רָטַב.—b) 
<italic>to sprout with moisture, be sappy</italic>. Gen. R. s. 69 ה' מצות וכ' (Yalk. Jud. 38 הפריח) sprouted with good deeds &c., v. רָטַב.—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to distribute food</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="I00859">טָרָף</xref>.</definition>
<notes>]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִיטָּרֵף, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִיטָּרֵף 
<italic>to be tossed about, to be in a storm</italic> near the shore. Taan. III, 7 (19
<sup>a</sup>) על הספינה המִיטָּרֶפֶת וכ' for a ship which is seen from the coast to be tossed about; ib. 14
<sup>a</sup> המְטוֹרֶפֶת (v. supra; Ar. ed. Koh. נִטְרֶפֶת 
<italic>Nif</italic>.). Tosef. Sabb. XIII (XIV), 11 נִיטָּרְפָה ספינה וכ' the ship has been thrown back several times (was prevented from landing by the breakers).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="I00860">
<head-word>טְרַף, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<head-word>טְרֵיף</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to take by force, seize</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 14
<sup>a</sup> אתי … וטַרְפָהּ מיניה (not וטרפא) the creditor came and took it from him (by legal seizure); ib. וקא טָרֵיף ליה מיניה (Ms. H. וטַרְפָהּ מיניה).—ט' לקוחות to seize property sold by the debtor, v. לְקוּחוֹת. Ib. 19
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to throw, strike, knock down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. X, 29
<sup>a</sup> וטָרֵיף לון לארעא and let them fall down. Lam. R. to I, 5 ויִטְרוֹף גרמיה and let him throw himself down. Ib. to IV, 2 טְרוֹף קולתיך וכ' cast down thy pitcher before me; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to knock at, shake, rap</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 28
<sup>a</sup> ט' אבבא knocked at the door. Snh. 97
<sup>a</sup>.—Ib. 67
<sup>b</sup> ט' ליה בטבלא he struck the 
<italic>tabla</italic> before him; a. v. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to carp at, to contest the validity of a decision</italic>. Y. Snh. I, beg. 18
<sup>a</sup> בעי מִיטְרוֹף wanted to protest (against R. Isaac’s decision because he acted as a single judge).—5) 
<italic>to declare t’refah</italic>. Ḥull. 10
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. 48
<sup>b</sup> סבר … למִיטְרְפָהּ Mar … wanted to declare it 
<italic>t’refah;</italic> a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. טָרִיף a) 
<italic>struck down</italic> (in the agony of death). Targ. Jud. III, 25; IV, 22 (h. text נֹפֵל). Lam. R. to IV, 5 טְרִיפִין בקיקלא (not טריפון) lying on dunghills.—b) 
<italic>thrown away</italic>. Y. Snh. X, 29
<sup>a</sup> top הא טריפין לך they are thrown down before thee (cmp. טְרוּן).—c) (denom. of טרפא, v. טָרוּף) 
<italic>spotted, full of incisions; planed</italic>. Ned. 25
<sup>a</sup>; Shebu. 29
<sup>b</sup>, v. טָרוּף.—[Y. Shebi. I, end, 33
<sup>c</sup> א"ר יודן כד טריפן לעוביה, read with R. S. to Shebi. I, 8: א"ר יודן בר טרפון or טריפון, לעוביה being a corrupt tautography of ליעז' ב"י = ליעזר בן יעקב.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>טָרֵיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to knock, strike, dash</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Kings VIII, 12 (h. text רטש). Targ. Nah. II, 8 (h. text תפף).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to prey, wait for prey</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. XXIII, 28 מְטָרֵף.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to drive about</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. מְטַרַף. Targ. Y. I Ex. XIV, 3 (ed. Amst. מִטַּ' 
<italic>Ithpa.</italic>). Targ. Y. II Num. XII, 12 מְטַרָפָא.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to agitate, trouble</italic>, v. infra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיטָּרֵיף, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיטְּרִיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be knocked about, dashed; to be tossed about; to be in spasms</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XIII, 16. Ib. LI, 20; a. e.—Lev. R. s. 12 beg. כהד' אילפא דמִיטָּרְפָא וכ' like the ship that is tossed about in the breakers &c. Snh. 95
<sup>a</sup> אתו יונה אי' קמיה a dove came down and rolled before him in spasms.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to be agitated, troubled</italic>. Targ. Gen. XLI, 8 (some ed. מְטַר' Part. pass. 
<italic>Pa.</italic>, v. supra). Targ. Ps. LXXVII, 5; a. fr.—Y. Taan. I, 64
<sup>b</sup> bot. למה אִיטָּרְפוּן … להכא why did the rabbis (you) take the trouble of coming hither.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be spotted, full, of incisions</italic> &c., v. supra a. 
<xref rid="I00439">טָרוּף.</xref></definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become</italic>, or 
<italic>be t’refah</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 57
<sup>b</sup> במידי דמִיטָּרְפָה בה in the same limb through the mutilation of which the animal became 
<italic>t’refah</italic>. Ib. 48
<sup>a</sup> דלאו מיניה מיטָּרְפָא where the 
<pgbrk id="pg557" />cause of its being 
<italic>t’refah</italic> lies not in the mutilated limb itself.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="I00862">

<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>prey</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 47
<sup>b</sup>, v. טָרַף.—Gen. R. s. 99 (ref. to מטרף, Gen. XLIX, 9) מטַרְפּוֹ של יוסף from making Joseph a prey, i.e. saving Joseph; מטַרְפָּהּ של תמר saving Tamar. Yalk. Ps. 637; Midr. Till. to Ps. VII, ed. Bub. יושב על טַרְפּוֹ (oth. ed. טְרֵפָתוֹ) sits over his prey.</notes></sense>

<entry id="I00863">

<sup>b</sup> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00864">
<head-word>טַרְפָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<head-word>טְרַף</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>leaf</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. VIII, 11. Targ. Is. XXXIV, 4; a. fr.—Ḥull. 47
<sup>b</sup> ט' דאסא leaf of a myrtle; a. fr.—Nidd. 20
<sup>a</sup> ט' מציעתא fem. (Rashi: מציעא), v. infra.—Trnsf. ט' דנחירי 
<italic>wing of the nose</italic>. Ber. 55
<sup>b</sup>.—
<plural-form>Pl. טַרְפַיָּא, טַרְפֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Gen. III, 7; a. fr.—Succ. 37
<sup>b</sup> נתרי ט' leaves may fall off. Sabb. 129
<sup>a</sup> חמרא בר הלתא ט' Rashi (ed. בת) wine of a vine that has changed foliage three times, i.e. wine in its third year. Nidd. l. c. טַרְפָן fem., v. דָּרָא I.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
